mapper.sql: FROM trade a LEFT JOIN aftersales_refund b ON a.order_id = b.order_id AND b.refund_status = 'SUCCESS' LEFT JOIN orders_normal_orders c ON a.order_id = c.order_id
mapper.select:
SELECT a.trade_id AS tradeId, a.pay_type AS payType, a.order_id AS orderId, a.total_fee AS totalFee, a.pay_fee AS payFee, COALESCE(SUM(b.refunded_fee), 0) AS refundedFee, a.bspay_div_status AS bspayDivStatus, a.bspay_fee_mode AS bspayFeeMode, a.bspay_fee AS bspayFee, a.time_start AS timeStart, a.distributor_id AS distributorId, a.pay_channel AS payChannel, MAX(c.order_auto_close_aftersales_time) AS closeAftersalesTime, MAX(c.order_id) AS normalOrderId
ORDER BY MAX(a.time_start) DESC

SELECT a.trade_id AS tradeId, a.pay_type AS payType, a.order_id AS orderId, a.total_fee AS totalFee, a.pay_fee AS payFee, COALESCE(SUM(b.refunded_fee), 0) AS refundedFee, a.bspay_div_status AS bspayDivStatus, a.bspay_fee_mode AS bspayFeeMode, a.bspay_fee AS bspayFee, a.time_start AS timeStart, a.distributor_id AS distributorId, a.pay_channel AS payChannel, MAX(c.order_auto_close_aftersales_time) AS closeAftersalesTime, MAX(c.order_id) AS normalOrderId
ORDER BY MAX(a.time_start) DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
